info.title: Venora API
info.description: Next.js Route Handlers and Supabase Edge Functions confirmed at commit 15e6173b6f695f6d9f5f4a29517badf0b3a3a016. Server Actions and PostgreSQL RPCs are documented separately and are not represented as fake REST routes.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Supabase auth callback and session termination

get.description: Returns bookings owned by the current user, newest first. Reads bookings and venue summaries. Safe and not application-rate-limited.

post.description: Creates a booking through create_booking_inquiry. Database checks publication, capacity, date conflicts, caller, and state; writes history/notifications and synchronizes availability. Duplicate active slots conflict. Not application-rate-limited.

patch.description: Approves, declines, cancels, or completes through workflow RPCs. Approve/decline require venue organization management or admin; RPCs recheck authorization and state. Side effects include history, invoice, notifications, availability, and cache revalidation.

post.description: Starts or resumes the deposit checkout. The RPC locks/reuses one pending transaction; hosted sessions younger than 55 minutes are reused; first-attach-wins persistence converges races. Only PayMongo is registered when configured.
Creates an eligible refund, invokes the provider, records correlation, and may complete synchronously. Customer, venue participant, or admin permission is enforced by RPC; later webhooks reconcile.
Atomically creates venue, packages, and amenities through create_venue_transaction. Requires venue_owner, event_coordinator, or admin and valid organization access. Not idempotent.

get.description: Filters and paginates accredited supplier profiles in application memory. Database errors or empty results fall back to bundled sample suppliers. Safe and not application-rate-limited.

parameters.name: accreditedOnly
parameters.description: Accepted but public query already requires accreditation

get.description: Returns one accredited supplier by UUID or slug with services, portfolio, and reviews. May return a matching bundled sample supplier.

post.description: Creates a contact request for an accredited supplier. Not idempotent; repeat submissions create multiple inquiries.

example.message: Please send package availability for our event.

get.description: Bootstraps preferences, then returns current user's non-expired notifications and unread count. Safe except for idempotent preference creation.

post.description: Marks one current-user notification read through mark_notification_read. Idempotent.
Marks all current-user notifications read and returns count. Idempotent after first call.

get.description: Returns current-user preferences and idempotently inserts defaults when absent.

patch.description: Upserts current-user preferences. SMS is always persisted disabled. Idempotent last-write-wins update.

get.description: Returns the intentionally public Web Push VAPID key. The private key remains server-only.

post.description: Upserts current-user push subscription by user and endpoint and clears disabled_at. Idempotent for the same endpoint.

delete.description: Sets disabled_at for the current user's endpoint. Repeating is harmless.

get.description: Returns private/no-store CSV or PDF scoped to venues belonging to organizations the venue_owner, event_coordinator, or admin owns or belongs to. Read-only.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start date; defaults to a 12-month range

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date; must be on/after from

get.description: Returns platform-wide CSV or PDF. Requires reports.export and writes report_exports plus audit_logs, so GET has an audit side effect.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start date; defaults to a 12-month range

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date; must be on/after from

post.description: Verifies timestamped HMAC over the raw body, atomically claims provider event ID, reconciles stored checkout/payment/refund context, and records outcome. Duplicate/skipped events return 200; 500 asks PayMongo to retry.

Placeholder receiver. Verifies HMAC-SHA512; failure statuses can fail a payment, but success reconciliation deliberately throws because no current Maya gateway/correlation exists. No event claim/idempotency. Do not enable in production.

500.description: Processing failed or success path not implemented

get.description: Handles PKCE/OAuth code exchange, provider errors, and email-token handoff. Returns redirects only and maps raw provider details to stable login error codes.

307.description: Temporary redirect variant emitted by Next.js

get.description: Calls Supabase signOut, clears auth cookies, and redirects home. Safe to repeat.

307.description: Temporary redirect variant emitted by Next.js

get.summary: Return not found for the disabled diagnostic route
get.description: The former diagnostic implementation is disabled. Every request receives an empty 404 response and no user, inquiry, environment, stack, or configuration data.

404.description: Not found; diagnostic endpoint is disabled

post.description: Parses natural language and filters, optionally warms embeddings, invokes search_venues, and writes search/usage logs. AI parsing degrades to deterministic extraction. Each call writes a search log.
Requires authenticated customer context. Ranks cold-start/personalized venues and writes recommendation impression events and usage logs. Repeat calls create new impressions.
Requires venue organization membership or admin. Applies moderation/usage limits, generates bounded copy, logs usage, and inserts a draft. Never publishes automatically and is not idempotent.
Returns deterministic comparison for 2-4 active packages and optional AI narrative. AI failure/disable/limits degrade to a null summary. Writes a comparison log.
Loads a published venue/packages, generates and validates a PHP itemized estimate with one retry, logs usage, and stores generated content. Not idempotent.

Creates/resumes a conversation, optionally adds authenticated user's booking context, persists messages/usage, and streams SSE. First event carries conversationId. Maximum 100 messages per conversation.

example.message: Show venues for 120 guests in Cebu.

200.description: SSE stream; first event contains conversationId, followed by OpenAI-compatible chunks

post.description: Internal queue endpoint expected behind platform JWT/service invocation. Dispatches one delivery or a batch, updates attempts/status, retries failed rows, and skips SMS. Do not expose publicly.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase access token. Never use a service-role token in browser code.

supabaseSession.name: sb-<project-ref>-auth-token
supabaseSession.description: Supabase SSR session cookie; the actual value can be chunked.

paymongoSignature.name: Paymongo-Signature
paymongoSignature.description: Timestamped PayMongo HMAC over the raw body.

mayaSignature.name: x-maya-signature
mayaSignature.description: Maya HMAC-SHA512 over the raw body.

ErrorDetail.description: Safe structured validation details, often from Zod flatten() or format().

PaymentProvider.description: Only PayMongo currently has a registered gateway when configured.

simulate_error.description: Rollback test flag present in implementation. Production clients should omit it.

Forbidden.description: Caller lacks role, permission, or ownership

error.message: Venue is unavailable on the selected date.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Required provider, workflow, or configuration unavailable
